dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A slight, localized asymmetrical bulge is present on the left lateral margin relative to the right margin at the mid-body area.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal area, indicating a juvenile or sub-adult skin tone phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency mottling characterized by diffuse, lighter-grey patches distributed across the central and lateral dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between localized pigmented variations and the primary medium-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A sharp, high-contrast longitudinal white mark on the posterior dorsal ridge; several short, high-contrast linear white markings on the cranial region posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent longitudinal white scar on the posterior peduncle and multiple faint, linear rake-like marks on the cranial-dorsal surface.
